summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics furnished a 6-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after its ADSs failed the $1.00 minimum bid price test over the 30 business days ending March 12, 2026. Nasdaq's September 18, 2026 letter confirmed 19 consecutive business days, from August 21 through September 17, 2026, with closing bids at or above $1.00, closing the matter. CEO Amir Reichman commented; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond the listing cure were disclosed. The risk-arb angle is residual delisting exposure if the bid sags again.
